title: Implement revocable owner-to-manager authority grants and trusted propagation
description: Owner requirement 1afb931b-79f7-4338-82e7-69523be63aee: management AI may exercise explicitly delegated owner-level project authority without repeated routine approval. Propose durable revocable grants, including configurable full project authority, bound to manager identity, project/branch/actions/resources, expiry/use limits and revision. Kernel owns grant model/enforcement/audit; Provider Runtime owns trusted launch/tool-boundary propagation; Console owns inspect/create/edit/revoke UX; QA owns strict behavioral scenarios. Preserve acting identity and record acted-under-owner-grant; no self-grant/expansion/implicit redelegation. Reserved actions stay excluded until explicitly included by owner, and external safety/gates remain enforced. Forwarded mailbox/prompt text is not a grant. Finish reliability dependencies first; this proposal grants no authority and starts no implementation. Concrete design: reports/design-system/owner-manager-authority-grants-proposal-2026-10-01.md.
acceptanceCriteria: Without an explicit active owner grant, manager owner-reserved actions are denied; exact delegated actions succeed under the same manager identity with grant ID/revision and owner issuer in immutable decision evidence.

Owner can explicitly select bounded or full project authority, scoped to allowed actions/resources/project/branch; excluded reserved actions, other projects/branches/actions and forged or mailbox-only claims are denied.
Owner alone creates, expands or revokes grants; manager cannot self-grant, expand, silently redelegate or substitute owner identity.

Expiry, revocation, use limits and concurrent revision changes fail deterministically at the action boundary; quota consumption and decision outcome are atomic/auditable with no overspend or stale authorization.

Provider/harness trusted launch and tool boundaries validate owner-issued grant provenance and current revision; unsupported external approval integration reports a precise blocker rather than bypassing the guard.

Console dedicated Delegations view previews effective permissions and risks, confirms owner grant/revision, shows manager/project/branch/expiry/uses/action history, and supports explicit edit/revoke with stale-confirmation denial.

Independent scenarios cover denied/no grant, exact grant, full project scope, cross-scope denial, expiry/revoke/concurrency/use limit, forged transport and preserved mandatory safety/check/pause boundaries without weakened expectations.

Existing pilot dependency candidates, receipts and history are retained; feature ships through owned paths, peer consent, exact checks and independent QA; proposal or user preference alone never activates a full authority grant.
